history.summary: Sri Sati Temple corresponds to the Shri Sati Bhavani Temple at Bhatlem, Altinho, Panaji, Goa - a neighbourhood temple dedicated to Sati Bhavani, a local mother-goddess form. A YouTube vlog of its 47th Vardhapandin (temple consecration-anniversary festival, with morning pooja, havan, mahaprasad and palki sohla) was uploaded in 2026, which would place the temple's founding around 1979 - UNVERIFIED, no published history or founding record was found. Nothing is known from reliable sources about its builder, dynasty or exact consecration year; treat the ~1979 inference as provisional (verify). Coordinates are approximate from a social-media place listing (verify).

town_description: Panaji (Panjim) is the capital city of Goa, set on the southern bank of the Mandovi River estuary in North Goa district. It became the Portuguese capital of Goa in 1843 and retains a colonial character in its Latin Quarter of Fontainhas, while Altinho Hill hosts the archbishop's palace and state government buildings. It is the state's administrative and cultural centre and the main gateway for North Goa tourism.
